criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve supplied demand records without adding unrelated candidates
keep unsupported needs visible when no capability exists

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage matches each supplied need against the supplied capabilities, preserves all allowed input record_ids, and marks only unmatched needs unsupported. The final coverage output is consistent with the target input and the declared role.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs ahead of direct coverage
use provenance rank within unsupported/direct groups
avoid treating repeated history as independent demand corroboration

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs ranks unsupported needs ahead of directly covered needs and uses upstream provenance rank as the within-group ordering key. The produced priorities show unsupported n06-r01 and n06-r07 first, then direct records in provenance order.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: derive top_need from already-ranked first record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the bounded priority window and constructs the recommendation from the first ranked record. Because the first priority is unsupported n06-r01, the deterministic recommendation correctly prioritizes isolate faulty execution branches before replay.
